title: Send an order to your customer
intro: Here's how to handle an order, from paid to delivered.

steps.caption: Orders that need you
steps.vo: Open Orders. Needs action shows the orders you still have to pack and send.

steps.caption: Open the order
steps.vo: Tap an order to see what they bought, how much they paid, and the delivery.

steps.caption: Call or WhatsApp the buyer
steps.vo: Their address and phone number are here. Tap Call or WhatsApp to reach them in one tap.

steps.caption: Track the delivery
steps.vo: Track shows every step: paid, being prepared, picked up and delivered.

steps.caption: Record a sale
steps.vo: Sold something in person? Tap the plus button and record a sale, so all your sales are in one place.

outro: Keep your customers updated, and they'll come back.
